faces.name: Tend the Pests
faces.oracleText:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Create X 1/1 black and green Pest creature tokens with "When this token dies, you gain 1 life," where X is the sacrificed creature's power.

faces.name: Tend the Sprigs
faces.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Then if you control seven or more lands and/or Treefolk, create a 3/4 green Treefolk creature token with reach. (It can block creatures with flying.)

faces.name: Tend to the Kiln
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, all non-Elemental instant and sorcery cards you own perpetually become Elemental kindreds in addition to their other types.
Whenever you cast an Elemental spell, put a flame counter on this enchantment. Then if it has three or more flame counters on it, remove them, conjure a card named Flamebraider onto the battlefield, and it gains haste and "At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this creature."
